expected_heading: Permissions and APIs that Access Sensitive Information
section: Permissions and APIs that Access Sensitive Information
paraphrase: Request a sensitive permission only for a feature that exists and is promoted in the listing, in context, and use the data only as consented; never sell it. Restricted permissions carry extra conditions: honour a refusal and keep the app usable; SMS and call-log permissions only for the default handler; location at the minimum scope, background only for a core feature; all-files access only after Google's review; broad package visibility only for named use cases; the accessibility API never to change settings or defeat platform controls, and always documented in the listing; install-packages only for apps whose core is sending or installing packages; body sensors and Health Connect under the health policy and approved uses; exact alarms only for alarm, timer or calendar apps; full-screen intent granted only to alarm and call apps; photo and video permissions on Android 13 or later only where the photo picker is not enough, with a declaration; age-signal data only for legal compliance.
quote: You may not use permissions or APIs that access sensitive information that give access to user or device data for undisclosed, unimplemented, or disallowed features or purposes.
